title: Quick Gooey Portuguese Chicken Tacos
description: A garlicky and gooey Portuguese dish featuring chicken, served in hard taco shells, made in one pot and air fried for a crispy touch, following ayurvedic tamasic friendly principles
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes
Add the garlic, onion, and portuguese sausage to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent
Add the chili powder and paprika to the skillet and stir to combine
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the flavors are combined
Use an air fryer to crisp the hard taco shells, cooking at 375 degrees for 2-3 minutes
Assemble the tacos by spooning the chicken mixture into the taco shells
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
